title: Descent from fixed coherent pullback comparison data
statement: Given a fixed pullback comparison family, its component identifications with commonStagePullbackComparison, and the tower coherence equation, there exists a unique functor on the common-stage constructible pair category with the prescribed common-stage object and representative formulas.

source.place: common-stage pullback paragraph, descent after comparison coherence

proof.text: Apply StageSystem.coefficientPairFunctor_exists to the coherent family b. First prove the generic conversion over abstract stage systems: its object formula equals the literal pair (stage P, phi(stage P)(P.obj)); after destructing the source pairs, the supplied heterogeneous component identifications become equalities and rewrite the representative formula in both directions. Apply existsUnique_congr to preserve uniqueness. Specialize to the rational pullback stage systems and commonStagePullbackComparison; hb supplies both component equalities.

proof_origin.place: K2 proof of commonStagePullback_descent_from_data via the private generic pairDescent_with_components helper

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullback_descent_from_data {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (b : ∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f) ⋙
          (stageSystem l Ω X).T h ≅
        (stageSystem l Ω Y).T h ⋙
          (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f))
    (hb : ∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L)
        (P : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
        HEq ((b h).hom.app P)
          ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f ⟨E, P⟩ L h).hom) ∧
        HEq ((b h).inv.app P)
          ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f ⟨E, P⟩ L h).inv))
    (hcoh : ∀ {E L M : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (h' : L ≤ M)
        (P : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
        ((stageSystem l Ω X).T h').map ((b h).hom.app P) ≫
          (b h').hom.app (((stageSystem l Ω Y).T h).obj P) ≫
          (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω M) f).map
            (((stageSystem l Ω Y).assoc h h').hom.app P) =
        (((stageSystem l Ω X).assoc h h').hom.app
            ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f).obj P) ≫
          (b (h.trans h')).hom.app P)) :
    ∃! F : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y ⥤
        generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X,
      (∀ P, F.obj P = commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f P) ∧
      (∀ (P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y)
        (L : Index l Ω) (hP : P.stage ≤ L) (hQ : Q.stage ≤ L)
        (a : P.toStage hP ⟶ Q.toStage hQ),
        HEq (F.map (X := P) (Y := Q) (ofHom P Q L hP hQ a))
          (ofHom (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f P)
            (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f Q) L hP hQ
            ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f P L hP).hom ≫
              (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map a ≫
              (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f Q L hQ).inv)))
